messages:
maya: running into flaky SSL errors from our Dedicated endpoint when using the async python SDK behind corp proxy. then the client starts spamming token refreshes and we hit rate limits. anyone seen a proxy+custom-CA+async combo?

sam: can you paste the error logs and say whether this is httpx/httpcore under the hood? async vs sync handling differs.

maya: logs:

maya: ```
ssl.SSLError: [SSL: CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED] certificate verify failed: self signed certificate in certificate chain
httpx._exceptions.ProxyError: SSL transport error while talking to proxy 10.0.0.5:3128
2024-11-02T15:12:01Z redwood-python v0.12.0 async token refresh -> 502 from proxy
2024-11-02T15:12:02Z redwood-python retrying token refresh (attempt 4)
2024-11-02T15:12:02Z redwood-python spawned parallel refresh request (no de-dupe)
```

jordan: that stack looks like the AsyncClient didn't get a proper SSLContext; passing a path to verify sometimes doesn't propagate into httpcore's proxy TLS handshake. which env/config did you set?

maya: set REDWOOD_CA_BUNDLE=/etc/ssl/certs/corp-ca.pem and left SDK to wire it. sync calls were OK, async hit this.

sam: try creating ssl.SSLContext(cafile=...) and pass it as verify to AsyncClient, and set trust_env=False so system env proxies don't interfere. quick snippet: 

sam: ```py
import ssl, os, httpx
ctx = ssl.create_default_context(cafile=os.environ['REDWOOD_CA_BUNDLE'])
client = httpx.AsyncClient(proxies='http://10.0.0.5:3128', verify=ctx, trust_env=False, base_url='https://dedicated.customer.internal')
# use client for async calls
```

lee: also note an SDK bug: token refresh is not serialized for async callers. if one request notices expiry, multiple concurrent tasks will try to refresh and the retry policy treats transient proxy 5xx as retriable, so you get thundering herd. we should add a refresh lock or singleflight.

maya: exactly what we saw. after the proxy returned 502 a few times the SDK kept retrying and spawned more refreshes. ended up with 8 refresh attempts in 10s.

jordan: short-term workaround: set REDWOOD_RETRY_ON_AUTH_FAIL=false or set an env flag to force single refresh (internal flag exists but not public yet). longer term we should accept either ca_bundle path or an SSLContext in public API and document the async proxy caveat.

maya: opened issue in internal repo: SDK-1423 "async client: proxy + custom CA -> SSL failures + parallel token refresh" with logs and a repro. attached snippet that uses SSLContext.

sam: also watch base_url input: if you pass a base_url with a path suffix (example: https://dedicated.customer.internal/prefix) the SDK concatenation for auth can produce duplicate paths (base_url + '/oauth/token'), causing 404s or proxy 502s depending on routing. prefer passing host-only or SDK should normalize.

infra-bot: staging-proxy maintenance window 2024-11-05T02:00Z - cert rotation may cause transient verifies.

lee: proposed devex changes: 1) doc: async proxy+CA pattern with SSLContext example; 2) SDK: accept ssl_context param for AsyncClient verify; 3) add token-refresh mutex for async flows and improve retry jitter; 4) better error messages that mention proxy re-signing and trust_env suggestions.

maya: tried the SSLContext + trust_env=False change, it resolved the SSL errors for us. still want the SDK fix so other teams don't have to patch. thanks! :thumbsup:

sam: filed RFC for the SDK changes and assigned to eng-ml infra. will update when there's a patch for v0.12.1.
